universal.zh: 油壓推活塞，把來令片夾住碟盤。單活塞浮動卡鉗只有一邊有活塞，整個卡鉗會滑動讓兩邊都夾到。
universal.en: Hydraulic pressure pushes a piston so the pads pinch the disc. A single-piston floating caliper has a piston on one side only; the whole caliper slides so both pads grip.

specific.zh: F30 320i 前後都是單活塞浮動卡鉗（待查證）。只換來令片不用拆油管；拆整個卡鉗才要放油。
specific.en: The F30 320i has single-piston floating calipers front and rear (unverified). Pad changes do not need the hose off; only full caliper removal does.

fasteners.desc: 卡鉗導銷螺絲 / Guide pin bolts

warnings.en: If the hose comes off, the system must be bled.

warnings.zh: 不要把卡鉗吊在油管上。
warnings.en: Never let the caliper hang by its hose.

commonIssues.zh: 導銷卡死造成單邊磨損、煞車偏；活塞回不去發熱。
commonIssues.en: Seized guide pins wear one pad and pull to one side; a stuck piston overheats.

universal.zh: 摩擦材料貼在鋼背上，夾碟盤的就是它。磨到警示線就該換。
universal.en: Friction material on a steel backing plate; this is what grips the disc. Replace at the wear line.

specific.zh: BMW 有磨耗感知線，前後各一側（待查證），換片時通常一起換。
specific.en: BMW fits a wear sensor on one side per axle (unverified), usually replaced with the pads.

commonIssues.en: Wear warning on the dash; squeal.

universal.zh: 鑄鐵圓盤跟著輪子轉，被來令片夾住就減速。前碟常是通風式（兩層中間有風道）。
universal.en: A cast-iron disc that turns with the wheel; pinching it slows the car. Front discs are usually vented, with air passages between two faces.

specific.zh: F30 320i 標準煞車：前碟 300 mm × 22 mm（通風）、後碟 300 mm × 20 mm（Brembo 零件目錄）。選配 M Sport 煞車是前 340 mm、後 345 mm。後碟的帽裡有手煞車鼓。一顆定位螺絲固定在輪轂上。
specific.en: F30 320i standard brakes: front disc 300 × 22 mm (vented), rear 300 × 20 mm (Brembo catalogue). Optional M Sport brakes use 340 mm front and 345 mm rear. The rear hat doubles as the handbrake drum. One set screw holds it to the hub.

commonIssues.zh: 碟盤厚薄不均煞車抖；生鏽的唇邊。
commonIssues.en: Thickness variation causes judder; a rusty lip at the edge.

universal.zh: 踩踏板 → 真空倍力器放大力量 → 總泵把煞車油推到四個輪子。油壺就在上面。
universal.en: Pedal → vacuum booster multiplies the effort → master cylinder pushes fluid to all four wheels. The reservoir sits on top.

specific.zh: 在防火牆駕駛座側。N20 有電動真空泵幫倍力器（待查證），因為渦輪引擎進氣真空不穩。
specific.en: On the firewall, driver's side. The N20 uses an electric vacuum pump for the booster (unverified) because a turbo engine's manifold vacuum is unreliable.

warnings.zh: 煞車油吸水，開封後一年內用完；沾到烤漆會腐蝕。
warnings.en: Brake fluid absorbs water; use an open bottle within a year, and keep it off paint.

universal.zh: 一組電磁閥和泵，可以在煞車時個別放掉某個輪子的壓力（ABS），或在車身打滑時主動煞某一輪（穩定系統）。
universal.en: A block of solenoid valves and a pump that can bleed pressure from one wheel during braking (ABS) or brake one wheel on its own when the car slides (stability control).

specific.zh: BMW 叫 DSC。換模組後要用診斷電腦編碼與排氣。
specific.en: BMW calls it DSC. A replacement needs coding and a diagnostic bleed.

warnings.zh: 六根油管位置做記號，接錯輪子會煞不住。
warnings.en: Label all six lines; swapping two means a wheel brakes wrongly.
